claim: The efficiency posture for a 24 GB local Mac: cheap deterministic paths first, heavy work opt-in and off the hot path, generation bounded, and back off under host pressure. HEAVY INTAKE IS OPT-IN: OCR/STT never auto-spin a model (ANIMA_INTAKE_ACTIVATE_HEAVY default-off -> needs_dependency). LERF/DETERMINISTIC FIRST: task turns route through the LERF-FIRST seam (a certified skill answers without the LLM) and reference recall is deterministic (model-free). BOUNDED: the reply has a token floor + ceiling and is capped to the floor under host pressure (no large model route). NO HEAVY WORK ON THE HOT PATH: the turn runs no OCR/STT/decode — heavy parsing is intake-time and queued. BACKS OFF: heavy intake defers and the model unloads (keep_alive=0) under red. DIAGNOSABLE: per-stage timing (llm/tts/tok-s) is instrumented every turn.
owner: anima/intake_audio.py (_heavy_on opt-in gate), anima/server.py (LERF-FIRST routing), anima/source_aware.py (deterministic recall), anima/mouth.py (token bounds + pressure cap + per-stage timing), anima/host_pressure.py (defer + unload under pressure), scripts/certify_performance.py

killer_test.name: heavy_opt_in_lerf_first_bounded_light_hot_path_backs_off
killer_test.setup: scripts/certify_performance.py proves: heavy transcription is opt-in (default-off -> needs_dependency, no model spun); task turns route LERF-FIRST and reference recall is model-free; the reply is token-bounded and capped under pressure; the live answer path runs no OCR/STT/decode; the turn defers + unloads under host pressure; per-stage timing is instrumented.
killer_test.prompt: drop a file / ask a task / answer under load

known_gaps: Quantitative latency/throughput budgets (e.g. p95 turn under N ms) and a perf-trace dashboard are a future refinement; today the cert proves the STRUCTURAL efficiency posture (cheap-first, opt-in heavy, bounded, backs off) that keeps the hot path light on a memory-constrained Mac.
